scope: K3 client transport feedback and manual recovery; not G1/G2 or model quality acceptance

http.unstructured_503: fixed unavailable/possibly busy guidance; never echo the raw body or assert an overload cause
http.structured_errors: preserve existing bounded application detail including MODEL_NOT_READY
http.opaque_network_failure: backend/address/CORS checks plus closing other connections and manual retry; status and cause remain unknown
http.reader: retain 128 KiB chunk-count budget, 30 second timeout, cancellation, no-store and redirect:error

websocket.1009: readable size-limit guidance, stop and release timers/pending frame; manual retry only
websocket.1013: temporarily unavailable/busy guidance; no automatic retry
websocket.other_closes: generic disconnect guidance; ignore untrusted close reason
websocket.local_frame: before send reject empty, non-JPEG or greater-than-2097152-byte encoding; exact bound permitted
websocket.lifecycle: keep generation isolation, single flight and deadlines; stop does not restart camera or auto-connect

validation.unit: message classification, bounded reading, local size/type, cleanup, stale callback and manual reconnect
validation.browser: installed Chrome and Edge; synthetic transport cases use real client code and are identified separately
validation.production_transport: unmodified loopback app and Uvicorn settings, no-model startup; real TCP overload and raw WebSocket oversized-message behavior; verify recovery after release
validation.limits: unreadable cross-origin 503 is an expected browser network failure, not proof that CORS was bypassed; raw oversize WS is distinct from client pre-send rejection
